question: With which sport is the oval stadium associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cricket:-**

 
 
• Cricket is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of eleven players on a cricket field, at the centre of which is a 22-yard-long (20 m) pitch with a wicket at each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps.
 
• The batting side tries to score runs by striking the ball bowled at the wicket with the bat, running between the wickets, and any balls that reach the boundary are worth four runs. When ten batsmen have been dismissed, the innings ends and the teams swap roles.
 
• The game is adjudicated by two umpires, aided by a third umpire and match referee in international matches.
 
• **The oval stadium is most commonly associated with cricket.**
 
• The oval shape of the stadium is well-suited for cricket, as it allows for a long boundary, which is important for scoring runs. The oval shape also provides a good viewing experience for spectators, as there is no obstruction from the stands.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football:-**

 
 
• It is a team sport played with an inflated ball by two teams of eleven players on a rectangular field with a goal at each end.
 
• The object of the game is to score more points than the other team by moving the ball down the field and kicking it into the opposing team's goal.
 
 
 
• **Hockey:-**
 
 
• It is a team sport played on ice skates with a stick and a puck.
 
• The object of the game is to score more goals than the other team by hitting the puck into the opposing team's net.
 
• Hockey is a fast-paced and exciting sport that is popular in many countries around the world. 
 
 
 
• **Basketball:-**
 
 
• It is a team sport played with a ball by two teams of five players on a rectangular court with a hoop at each end.
 
• The object of the game is to score more points than the other team by shooting the ball through the hoop.
 
• Basketball is a fast-paced and exciting sport that is popular in many countries around the world.
